ideas.title: Herding by smell
ideas.critique: This is 'The island by smell' from round 2 reworded, now with the player dropping scents to steer friends. A simulated field that decides where creatures walk changes how the island works, unlike another event. The visible wisps and the player-as-herder control make it playable, but the risk is that live the field reads as faint noise and the herding is invisible in a still.

ideas.title: Hybrids and their family tree
ideas.critique: This is the round 2 'Hybrids' idea again, now with the family tree as the visible point, which is the missing piece the critic asked for. Heredity with a lineage across sessions is a new kind of change. Mixed bodies from generated meshes are fragile and are still more creatures, and the tree on the wall must carry the whole post.

ideas.title: Your pointer is a moth
ideas.critique: Embodying the viewer's own mouse pointer as a creature friends chase is new: it is the first way to touch the island from the browser without jumping in, and it is playable by any visitor. Friends chasing a lure is a familiar gag, and it is hard to show in a film or a still, so the post must rely on a screen capture or a clip with a real pointer.
